title: Work order lines Delete allows removing lines
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders View and Work order lines Create & Edit and Delete.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order with several lines.
  2. Delete a non-critical line.
  3. Confirm.
custom_expected: The line is removed and the work order totals (if shown) update.
viu_status: Blocked-UI: WOL Delete role shows line-selection checkboxes but no line delete/remove button was exposed (selecting a line revealed no bulk-delete control; no per-line delete icon). Line-delete affordance not reachable in the harness; needs the expanded-line editor delete control or the line-delete endpoint confirmed.
